etymologies.heading: Etymology 1
paragraphs: Inherited from Middle English harye, variant of herwen, from Old English herġian, hergian, from Proto-West Germanic *harjōn, from Proto-Germanic *harjōną, from *harjaz (“army”), from Proto-Indo-European *koryos, from *ker- (“army”).
senses: To make repeated attacks on an enemy.

etymologies.heading: Etymology 2
senses: (India, obsolete) A menial servant; a sweeper.
